price_correction: Earlier out of sample median log residuals in predicted price bands above 1.5m; at least 200 cases, shrink n/(n+500), cap factor at 1/1.10 to 1.10
point_review_rule: Average MdAPE improvement at least 0.10 percentage points, MAPE worsening at most 0.10, worst window worsening at most 0.20, improvement in at least two of three windows
disclosure: All periods have been seen before. Treat results as exploratory. No model or submission files are changed.
